description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Rem
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Dagger Toss (0~2), removed after using Dagger Toss two times

description.name: Dagger Toss Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Dagger Toss level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Rem]

description.name: Dagger Toss Level
description.text: Keeps track of Dagger Toss level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Rem]
